name: loop_push_bicycle
text: Stand still beside the right side of an upright bicycle, left hand resting on the near handlebar. Left elbow bends naturally toward the bicycle, right arm hangs relaxed. Keep both feet planted beside the frame, clear of its wheels. Do not walk or pedal.
